name: task-tour-management-system
description: Tour Management System monorepo root: one-command install, test, lint and verification across the Express + MongoDB API and the React applications. See README.md.

scripts.setup: npm ci && npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend && npm ci --prefix admin && npm ci --prefix tourcompanydashboard
scripts.build:web: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix admin run build && npm --prefix tourcompanydashboard run build
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:web
scripts.test:web: npm --prefix frontend run test:ci && npm --prefix admin run test:ci && npm --prefix tourcompanydashboard run test:ci
scripts.test:offline: npm run test:backend:unit && npm run test:web
scripts.test:coverage: npm --prefix backend run test:coverage && npm --prefix frontend run test:coverage && npm --prefix admin run test:coverage && npm --prefix tourcompanydashboard run test:coverage
scripts.dependency:audit: npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high && npm --prefix backend audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high && npm --prefix frontend audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high && npm --prefix admin audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high && npm --prefix tourcompanydashboard audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high
scripts.coverage:check: npm --prefix backend run coverage:check && npm --prefix frontend run coverage:check && npm --prefix admin run coverage:check && npm --prefix tourcompanydashboard run coverage:check
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix admin run lint && npm --prefix tourcompanydashboard run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix admin run typecheck && npm --prefix tourcompanydashboard run typecheck
scripts.verify: npm run dependency:check && npm run lint && npm run lint:root && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run verify:repo && npm test && npm run verify:build
